title: Atlas and Orchard
author: Juniper Galloway
blurb: Noor Vasquez, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
